summary: Modoboa is a self-hosted mail hosting and management platform designed to simplify the administration of email servers. It provides a web-based user interface to help operators manage mailboxes, domains, and associated services from a central dashboard.
goodFor: System administrators looking for an integrated web interface to manage email infrastructure on their own hardware without relying entirely on command-line tools.
watchOut: Email server administration carries a high operational burden regarding DNS configuration, IP reputation, and spam prevention, which this platform does not eliminate entirely.
deployNotes: As a Python application, it typically requires a WSGI server, a separate relational database, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and static file serving.
